::: {.callout-important appearance="simple"}
**Nothing has been checked by Andy.** Section 2 of the specification was
transcribed on 2026-10-13 from text extracted from the poster PDF. The
literature review was assembled the same day from abstracts, open-access full
text, and automated summaries of full text; its "read from" line on each
entry says which.
:::

The working document is [the specification](specification.qmd), the
literature review is [Tumor Models of Nontarget and New Lesions](literature-review.qmd),
and the folder's documents are on [the project index](index.qmd).

## Status markers

- ❌ **Not checked.** No claim in the project has been verified against this
  source.
- ⚠️ **Transcribed, unverified.** A number, equation or table in the project
  came from this source but has not been checked against it.
- ✅ **Checked.** Verified against the source.

On a reading-queue entry, ✅ means the question under the entry has been
answered. Change a marker when the check is done, not when the paper is
opened.

## Reading Queue

The first two entries answered open question 1 of the specification. The
rest are the ranked reading list from Section 10 of the literature review.

1. ✅ **Stein A, Wang W, Carter AA, Chiparus O, Hollaender N, Kim H, Motzer
   RJ, Sarr C.** Dynamic tumor modeling of the dose-response relationship for
   everolimus in metastatic renal cell carcinoma using data from the phase 3
   RECORD-1 trial. *BMC Cancer* 2012;12:311. PMC3495014.
   *Question:* Does it include nontarget and new lesions?
   *Answer:* No. Target lesions only; its reference 22 is the poster, cited
   for the nontarget and new lesion work.
2. ✅ **Stein A, Bellmunt J, Escudier B, Kim D, Stergiopoulos SG, Mietlowski
   W, Motzer R, et al.** Survival prediction in everolimus-treated patients
   with metastatic renal cell carcinoma incorporating tumor burden response
   in the RECORD-1 trial. *Eur Urol* 2013;64:994–1002. PMID 23219086.
   *Question:* Does it include the three-lesion model?
   *Answer:* No. A Cox analysis of overall survival in 246 everolimus
   patients; nontarget growth and new lesions are univariate predictors.
3. ❌ **Yu J, Wang N, Kågedal M.** A new method to model and predict
   progression free survival based on tumor growth dynamics. *CPT
   Pharmacometrics Syst Pharmacol* 2020;9:177–184. PMC7080535.
   *Question:* The hazard definition and simulation algorithm.
4. ⚠️ **Zecchin C, Gueorguieva I, Enas NH, Friberg LE.** Models for change in
   tumour size, appearance of new lesions and survival probability in
   patients with advanced epithelial ovarian cancer. *Br J Clin Pharmacol*
   2016;82:717–727. PMC5338128.
   *Question:* Check the Weibull coefficients quoted in review Section 3.3
   against Table 3.
5. ❌ **Krishnan SM, Friberg LE, Nyberg J, Sarr C, Niebecker R, Wang S, Perez
   Pitarch A.** A framework for prediction of progression free survival based
   on modelling of sub-endpoints. PAGE 30 (2022), abstract 10071.
   *Question:* Does drug exposure or SLD enter the nontarget and new lesion
   models? Is there a journal version?
6. ❌ **Kumar R, Thiagarajan K, Jagannathan L, et al.** Beyond the single
   average tumor: understanding IO combinations using a clinical QSP model
   that incorporates heterogeneity in patient response. *CPT Pharmacometrics
   Syst Pharmacol* 2021;10:684–695. PMC8302246.
   *Question:* The form of the nontarget progression probability.
7. ❌ **Litière S, et al.** The components of progression as explanatory
   variables for overall survival in the RECIST 1.1 database. *Eur J Cancer*
   2014 or 2015; the sources disagree on the year.
   *Question:* The share of progression events from each component, and the
   year.
8. ❌ **Bonate PL, Suttle AB.** Modeling tumor growth kinetics after treatment
   with pazopanib or placebo in patients with renal cell carcinoma. *Cancer
   Chemother Pharmacol* 2013;72:231–240. PMID 23715625.
9. ❌ **Liu H, Ibrahim EIK, Centanni M, Sarr C, Venkatakrishnan K, Friberg
   LE.** Integrated modeling of biomarkers, survival and safety in clinical
   oncology drug development. *Adv Drug Deliv Rev* 2025;216:115476. PMID
   39577694.
   *Question:* Does its reference list hold a nontarget or new lesion model
   the review missed?

## Sources Behind the Specification

10. ⚠️ **Stein AM, Carter A, Hollaender N, Motzer R, Sarr C.** Quantifying the
    effect of everolimus on both tumor growth and new metastases in metastatic
    renal cell carcinoma (RCC): a dynamic tumor model of the RECORD-1 phase
    III trial. *J Clin Oncol* 29, 2011 (suppl; abstr 4602). ASCO poster.
    [PDF](https://github.com/iamstein/Publications/blob/main/Posters/Stein11_ASCOposter_RAD_3lesions.pdf).
    Everything in Section 2 of the specification.
11. ❌ **Kim D, Stein A, Wang W, et al.** Dynamic tumor modeling of the
    RECORD-1 phase III trial of everolimus quantifies relationship between
    dose and tumor growth in metastatic renal cell carcinoma. 26th EAU Annual
    Congress, Vienna, March 2011, abstract 728. The target lesion model,
    presumably the conference version of entry 1.
12. ❌ **Motzer RJ, Escudier B, Oudard S, et al.** Efficacy of everolimus in
    advanced renal cell carcinoma: a double-blind, randomised,
    placebo-controlled phase III trial. *Lancet* 2008;372:449–456. The trial
    design, for Section 2.1.
13. ❌ **Motzer RJ, Escudier B, Oudard S, et al.** Phase 3 trial of everolimus
    for metastatic renal cell carcinoma: final results and analysis of
    prognostic factors. *Cancer* 2010;116:4256–4265. The final trial results.
